label: VERIFIED
extraction: Obsidian Local AI Agent: local-first plugin powered by Ollama. Autonomous multi-step vault tasks with no cloud services. Natural language tasks (e.g., 'move agent notes to Chats folder'), multi-step planning (list → read → move → synthesize via LLM), vault-aware tools (read, write, move, delete, list notes via Obsidian native API), conversation panel (sidebar UI with real-time progress, clickable task cards), local & private (all inference on machine via Ollama, nothing to cloud), task persistence (checkpoints survive restarts). Beta status, core features functional but not ready for general release. MIT license.
